title: Stay-awake hardening: AC power actions (revised)
description: Revised after task-002 refusal. This task covers AC-ONLY power actions. Global changes (hibernation, screensaver, lock screen) are separate and not included here.
objectives: Set lid close action to do nothing on AC power
Set power button action to do nothing on AC power
Set sleep button action to do nothing on AC power
Verify all three with powercfg and report every value
constraints: AC power settings only; leave battery settings unchanged
Do NOT disable hibernation at system level (out of scope for this task)
Reversible changes only; document rollback for each change
